dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if you don't use regular rounds?

dialogues.speaker: Gunther
dialogues.text: You mean... Use elemental projectiles instead, like the Fatui Skirmishers? *sigh* You think too highly of us.

dialogues.speaker: Gunther
dialogues.text: While our muskets are indeed based on technology from Snezhnaya, Fontaine, and Mondstadt, we're still missing certain core components that'd allow us to match the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Gunther
dialogues.text: Want regular folks like us to make use of elemental energy? You might as well get a squirrel to operate the jukebox at The Flagship.

dialogues.speaker: Gunther
dialogues.text: Unless we're talking some out-of-the-box solution, like packing the elemental components into a container and then chucking the whole thing... Based on my limited experience, there's not much we can do at this time.
